title: Stale review: a payload changed after review cannot be approved by hash match
risk: The reviewer approves a 10 percent discount while the stored payload now carries 40 percent, so an unreviewed commercial commitment executes under an approval that was given for something else.
preconditions: Namespace gov-apv-<case_id>-<worker_id>; approval queue seeded from fixtures/offline/governance.json.
Operator identities and roles resolved from the fixture operator registry; every decision goes through POST /api/v1/approvals/{id}/decision, the only approval route.
The operator script loads APV-CAMP-15 and captures payload_hash at review time.

steps.action: Load the approval item and record the reviewed payload_hash
steps.expected: The client receives the payload and its hash from the server, not from local storage.

steps.action: Mutate the stored payload discount to 0.40 while the item is still AWAITING_HUMAN
steps.expected: The stored payload_hash changes accordingly; the item remains AWAITING_HUMAN.

steps.action: Submit APPROVE carrying the reviewed hash
steps.expected: The decision is refused with a stale/conflict response; the item stays AWAITING_HUMAN and nothing executes.

steps.action: Refresh and approve the current payload explicitly
steps.expected: The refreshed decision succeeds and the released payload carries the 0.40 discount that was actually reviewed in the refreshed view.

assertions: An approval whose reviewed hash differs from the stored payload is refused; no execution occurs on the stale decision.
The refusal does not mutate the item state, so the work is not lost.
The released payload after refresh equals the stored payload at release time.
Both the reviewed and the mutated hash are retained for the audit trail.
forbidden: Matching on approval id alone and ignoring the payload hash.
Silently releasing the mutated payload because the item id matched.
Deleting the mutated payload so the history looks clean.
evidence: Approval record history showing the hash change and the later decision.
Released payload copy matched against the reviewed hash.
cleanup: Delete gov- approval rows after exporting the hash history.
automation: Real approval hash binding under test; the mutation is applied through the supported sandbox payload update path so the hash genuinely changes. No UI-only mock: the check runs server-side.
note: Generated acceptance specification. Plain specification, not an executable test; no application runtime exists, so the status is NOT_RUN.
